items.title: Germany transforms former coal mines into Europe's largest lake landscape
items.summary: 📝 There is even a community in the region called Neu-Seeland, around which the water landscape created from former open-cast mines has developed. A holiday region is growing step by step from a former lignite mining area. The rapid introduction of neutral river water fulfils an important purpose: it prevents acidic water from the tipping areas from entering the lakes.🔗 Read more: https://www.euronews.com/2026/04/14/almost-like-lake-como-germany-transforms-former-coal-mines-into-europes-largest-lake-lands

items.title: The Hetzner Cloud network stack – history and technical overview
items.summary: 📝 With the launch of Hetzner Cloud and the introduction of network features like Private Networks and Firewalls, we introduced Open vSwitch. Private network traffic is encapsulated using Virtual eXtensible LAN (VXLAN) and a unique Virtual Network Identifier (VNI) per private network. The host network stack ensures that only members attached to the respective private network can send or receive traffic.🔗 Read more: https://www.hetzner.com/blog/the-hetzner-cloud-network-stack-history-and-technical-overview/
